description: Stable agent error codes. Every response produced after successful key resolution, including 4xx/5xx, is signed and carries the error-response DTO {code, message, traceId}. The only unsigned answer is the unknownKey case.

codes.description: Malformed security headers, query string, non-canonical path, Content-Encoding or ambiguous Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding.
Body is not valid JSON or violates the route DTO schema.
Unknown enum value or unsupported protocol feature.
Request signature does not match the resolved agent secret.
Request timestamp is outside the +/-60 second window.
Request nonce was already used by this agent.
Stale or foreign claim: target agent, claim token hash, lease version or lease expiry do not match.
Raw body exceeds the route limit; the body is hashed streaming and the signature authenticated first.
Control plane temporarily unavailable, e.g. facility_unavailable.

unknownKey.description: X-Mucki-Agent-Key is unknown or so malformed that no secret can be resolved. Exactly one unsigned 401 with empty body is allowed; the agent treats it as terminal transport/authentication failure and never reads semantics or job/action data from it.
